decisions.briefing: Markets were quietly positive today with NASDAQ +0.3% and S&P 500 +0.5% — a neutral, low-conviction session. Cash on hand ($289.29) is below the $500 deployment threshold and today isn't a strong risk-on signal (NASDAQ +2%+), so per past lessons we're holding rather than forcing a buy into open slots. Existing positions are left to run; stop-loss and profit-target rules will handle exits automatically.

market_education.summary_en: Both major indices posted small gains today, with the S&P 500 slightly outpacing the NASDAQ, suggesting broad but unenthusiastic buying rather than a sector-specific rally. Moves of this size (under 1%) are typically noise-level and don't reflect a major shift in investor sentiment. Without a clear catalyst, this kind of day is best used to observe rather than chase new positions.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤溫和上揚,標普500升幅0.5%,略勝納指的0.3%,反映市場買盤較為廣泛而非集中於個別板塊。此等升幅低於1%,一般屬市場噪音範圍,未必代表投資氣氛出現重大轉變。在缺乏明確催化因素下,今日較適合觀望而非追高進場。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Dry powder means keeping cash in reserve instead of investing it immediately, so you have flexibility to act when a stronger opportunity appears. On a quiet, neutral market day like today, holding cash below the deployment threshold isn't wasted — it's positioning to buy more confidently when a real risk-on signal shows up.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」(Dry Powder)指投資者保留現金儲備,不急於全數投入市場,以便在更佳機會出現時保持靈活。像今日這種平靜、方向不明的市況,持有現金並非浪費機會,而是為日後出現明確的風險偏好信號時,能更有信心地加碼進場。
